artists.biography: The Avalanches are an Australian electronic music group formed in 1997 with mainstays Robbie Chater on keyboards, Tony Diblasi on keyboards, bass and backing vocals, and Darren Seltmann on vocals and keyboards. They are known for their live and recorded DJ sets and their debut album Since I Left You (2000), which they claim was assembled from approximately 3500 vinyl samples. The album peaked in the top 10 on the UK Albums Chart in April 2001. At the ARIA Music Awards of 2001, the group received nine nominations and won four categories: 'Best New Artist - Album' and 'Best Dance Release' for Since I Left You, 'Best New Artist - Single' for "Frontier Psychiatrist", and 'Producer of the Year' for Bobbydazzler (production name for Chater and Seltmann). In October 2010, the album was listed at No. 10 in the book, 100 Best Australian Albums. The Album has also been named # 1 Australian Album of all time in a Triple J industry poll, as well as # 10 album of the decade by Pitchfork Media. It is estimated in the decade since its release the album has gone on to sell well over 1,000,000 copies.

Since I Left You is the debut studio album by Australian electronic group The Avalanches, released on 27 November 2000 by Modular Recordings. The album is notable for its extensive use of sampling, reportedly incorporating around 3,500 vinyl samples from a wide range of genres. Produced primarily by Robbie Chater and Darren Seltmann, it was created by exchanging mixes between two near-identical studios, resulting in a seamless, collage-like sound that blends electronic, dance, and sample-based music into a cohesive whole.

Musically, Since I Left You is characterized by its lush, upbeat, and eclectic style, combining elements of disco, pop, soul, and funk through intricate sampling techniques. This approach gave the album a distinctive, joyous atmosphere that stood out in the electronic music scene of the early 2000s. It holds a significant place in The Avalanches' discography as their breakthrough work, setting a high standard for sample-based production and influencing many artists in electronic and indie music circles.

Critically, the album was widely acclaimed for its innovative production and creative use of samples, earning praise for its originality and joyful sound. Commercially, it performed well, charting notably on the US Top Electronic Albums and Top Heatseekers charts. The album's title track was released as a single in early 2001, further boosting its profile. Over time, Since I Left You has been regarded as a landmark electronic album and remains a cult favorite, celebrated for its artistry and enduring influence.
